title: Workflow AI Budget Admission Binding v1
description: Provider-neutral, versioned evidence binding carried unchanged from a Workflow Engine committed admission through Skill Runtime to AI Gateway. It creates neither a canonical identity nor a Gateway reservation.

BindingContractVersion.description: Unknown binding versions fail closed before Gateway acceptance or provider dispatch.

WorkflowAdmissionStateVersion.description: The existing Workflow-owned durable transition version at which the matching admission became Committed. It is a fence, not an identity.

GatewayIdempotencyKey.description: The existing target-owned, Tenant/Workspace-scoped Gateway idempotency key for this logical admission.

CommittedExposure.description: The exact Workflow-owned conservative exposure committed before Gateway acceptance. It is not a reservation or repricing.

opaqueId.description: Opaque printable ASCII identifier with no whitespace or control characters, including terminal CR or LF.

$comment: The durable logical admission key is the existing tuple (TenantId, WorkspaceId, WorkflowId, WorkflowStepId, CommandId, ExecutionId). WorkflowAdmissionStateVersion fences reuse of that tuple. GatewayIdempotencyKey is the existing target-owned replay key, not a new identity.
